content.short: Oku Trade is a professional DEX interface for Uniswap v3 concentrated liquidity, offering advanced charting, limit orders, and LP management on Mantle.
content.description: Oku Trade is a professional-grade decentralized exchange interface built on Uniswap v3 concentrated liquidity infrastructure, providing advanced charting tools, limit orders, and precision liquidity position management for DeFi traders. Users can bridge assets, execute token swaps, and manage concentrated liquidity positions with detailed analytics through Oku's feature-rich dashboard. Deployed on Mantle, Oku brings institutional-quality trading tools to the network's DeFi ecosystem.
